semantics_notes: official_id is the exact source ID; base_form_id is suffix after first digit and is an observed grouping convention, not a documented API contract.

shows_in_official_gallery is display metadata, not a proven shop availability rule.
effect_numeric_tokens and effect_keyword_tags are retrieval hints, not executable rules. Fetch official source for exact mechanics.
Official public resource URLs are observed frontend assets, not a promised/stable third-party API.
